runs.sql: SELECT DimProduct.ModelName, ROUND(SUM(FactInternetSales.SalesAmount), 2) AS internet_sales FROM FactInternetSales JOIN DimProduct ON FactInternetSales.ProductKey = DimProduct.ProductKey WHERE DimProduct.ModelName = 'Mountain-200' AND DimProduct.Color = 'Black' AND FactInternetSales.OrderDate BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31' GROUP BY DimProduct.ModelName
runs.first_sql: SELECT DimProduct.ModelName, internet_sales FROM FactInternetSales JOIN DimProduct ON FactInternetSales.ProductKey = DimProduct.ProductKey WHERE DimProduct.ModelName = 'Mountain-200' AND DimProduct.Color = 'Black' AND FactInternetSales.OrderDate BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31' GROUP BY DimProduct.ModelName, internet_sales

runs.question: Which product category had the highest reseller sales in 2013?
runs.text: Bikes: Reseller sales (USD) 26,942,691.1.
runs.sql: SELECT DimProductCategory.EnglishProductCategoryName, ROUND(SUM(FactResellerSales.SalesAmount), 2) AS reseller_sales FROM FactResellerSales JOIN DimProduct ON FactResellerSales.ProductKey = DimProduct.ProductKey JOIN DimProductSubcategory ON DimProduct.ProductSubcategoryKey = DimProductSubcategory.ProductSubcategoryKey JOIN DimProductCategory ON DimProductSubcategory.ProductCategoryKey = DimProductCategory.ProductCategoryKey WHERE FactResellerSales.OrderDate BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31' GROUP BY DimProductCategory.EnglishProductCategoryName ORDER BY reseller_sales DESC LIMIT 1

runs.first_sql: SELECT DimSalesTerritory.SalesTerritoryGroup, internet_sales FROM FactInternetSales JOIN DimSalesTerritory ON FactInternetSales.SalesTerritoryKey = DimSalesTerritory.SalesTerritoryKey WHERE FactInternetSales.OrderDate BETWEEN '2013-07-01' AND '2013-09-30' GROUP BY DimSalesTerritory.SalesTerritoryGroup

runs.question: How many online orders included helmets in France and Germany in 2013?
runs.text: Internet orders 1,287.
runs.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT FactInternetSales.SalesOrderNumber) AS internet_orders FROM FactInternetSales JOIN DimProduct ON FactInternetSales.ProductKey = DimProduct.ProductKey JOIN DimProductSubcategory ON DimProduct.ProductSubcategoryKey = DimProductSubcategory.ProductSubcategoryKey JOIN DimSalesTerritory ON FactInternetSales.SalesTerritoryKey = DimSalesTerritory.SalesTerritoryKey WHERE DimProductSubcategory.EnglishProductSubcategoryName = 'Helmets' AND DimSalesTerritory.SalesTerritoryRegion IN ('France', 'Germany') AND FactInternetSales.OrderDate BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31'

runs.question: What was the internet gross margin of Road Bikes in 2012?
